description:
---  Style: Whimsigoth perhaps
--- I always liked these gloves and boots. The coat and skirt breaks  from BLM's normal dark aesthetic and the Applewood accents it. The cape drapes to cover the odd tops of the gloves and exposes the snake faintly embossed into the glove leather, a detail the boots share. The cape also retains the dramatic robe effect I favor. 
--- lvl 60 option post - Noblesse Goetia
title: Unshadowed Goetia

description:
"Pay no mind ter my blade; just got it all sharpened by a good blacksmith an' I'm in a fine mood. Don't go spoilin' it an' givin' me reason fer a live test now!"

 --- noticed that the Darklight Claws for mages had a model for striking (and maiming) and had to have them. Love the unity of metallic accents here; even the gold on the boots works as it mirrors the gold trim on the scabbard's end. 
 circa Feb. 7, 2021
title: Rum Runner - Debonair

Whenever I find some blighter face down in the street covered in sores and we have to either haul him to the physician or the grave, I know that he’s there. Each time I hear rumours of the Green Pox making its way towards the city, I know that the Lord of Pestilence is laughing at us."

description:
Greetings!

Today I give you my new leveling set for...everything. Past lv 20 this set is wearable by every job there is. And I love it to death. Been listening to Sherlock Holmes for a few days again and I love the aesthetics of that time. And Ishgard presents itself as a perfect stage to boot! So here he is, the Eorzean Gentleman. Elegant, fashionable and with a matching tool for every job. Bonus points for Sage and Blue Mage tho! Also, the False Spectacles Fashion Accessoire..

Have Fun!
title: Eorzean Gentleman (All Jobs)

This set was an evolution to my Eorzean Gentleman. The new Baronial Attire just begged to be used in such a manner. Have Fun!

description:
Greetings!

The old Silverwolf goes East! This set was formed out of an rp-concept, a bit of my headcanon. In this, the old man had to travel east in the role of a bodyguard for his companion. I put the image of a ronin and a knight together and wanted to build a samurai with plate armor, essentially. The Kasuga-Set offered a solid foundation for that. Would have loved a Nagamaki of some sort, but the Higan Shigan is a very beautiful blade also.

Hope you like it!

Have Fun!
title: Koutetsukiri (Samurai)

description:
Greetings!

This set was build the instant I layed eyes on the Voidvessel Claws. I just loved the alien design and had to build something with it. The Gnath Arms were a given with these claws, after that the search began. To be honest, I did not plan to use more Gnath pieces, but it proved difficult to find other matching pieces with this very specific theme. So, it is a more "premade" set, but alas, I like it still. Gives me Yoshimitsu vibes!

Hope you like it!

Have Fun!
title: Parasite (Monk)

Still, hope you like it!

Have Fun!

description:
Over here, stranger!

This was inspired by a certain shifty merchant that comes around at the weirdest of times, carrying a surprising amount of weapons and upgrades. As long as you have the cash and don't ask where these things come from, you'll get along just fine! It's always worth to have a look at these wares, you know? Who knows when you'll need some healing materials, some ammo, a scope or an Infinite Rocket Launch-...what in the actual Fu-?!

Hope you like it!

Have Fun!
title: Suspicious Merchant (Machinist)

description:
Another in my series of exploring job-fantasy; this time for Black Mage. Something bookish & smart, and a little bit dorky/nerdy, in the traditional purple, black, & blue, with a tiny bit of steampunk flair. Tagged villainous because, well, have you EVER met a black mage who didn't like to make enemies go boom?
For those without the Emissary set who want to avoid Mog/cash sets: Replica Sky Pirate's Casting or Healing bottoms are very similar.
title: Nerd Mage - Black Mage in Violet Violence

The Praemagitek Hoods of Striking/Scouting/Aiming are the unsung champions of this set. The Maiming/Fending armor justifiably shines in the spotlight! These hoods align cleanly with collars/scarves on many different body pieces, and can be nearly matched with some dyes.

Legs are what's in slot, but marked as optional because they are hidden by the body gear.
title: You're a sight for sore eyes!

description:
Greetings!

Are you familiar with an animator called Gakilsam? This set was inspired by their works. Depicting a group of modern day people who unapologetically put nightmares, horror monsters and other creeps into the ground. These people make ghosts shiver. Fits a rather dark, industrial vibe. And gives me the opportunity to use a weapon that has been barely used in the entire Eorzea Collection! Don't mind if I do!

Hope you like it!

Have Fun!
title: Nightmare Hunter (Dark Knight)

Couldn't decide if I wanted something super casual or something arty for my PCT, in the end I decided on something more renaissance looking since my char looks like an older distinguished gentleman.

Not many notes on this one, the gear is all very easily accessible and aside from the boots it's all dyeable from the get go, but I didn't due them anyway. All the pieces bar the boots are cheap on the mb or easy to craft with older mats. Visor is off for the cap to use the headwear glasses.

description:
For this glam, I took a lot of inspiration from areas like Shaaloani. For some reason, the desert atmosphere immediately made me think about adding goggles, because of the sandstorms and that kind of explorer vibe.

The overall earthy color palette also gave me the right feeling for this Viper. Also, aren’t snakes usually associated with desert environments? I'm not entirely sure, but it felt like it matched the theme really well.
title: Shaaloani Viper
